abort.no_devices_found: No Dometic CFX device was found

confirm.description: Set up {name} ({address})? Put the cooler in PAIR mode. Home Assistant will connect and create a Bluetooth bond.

user.description: Select the Dometic CFX cooler to add.

source.description: Choose how Home Assistant connects to the cooler. A specific ESPHome proxy is strongly recommended: it keeps the Bluetooth bond across restarts. Automatic uses the nearest reachable adapter or proxy. Warning: with a local adapter (BlueZ), the bond is lost on every Home Assistant restart, so you must put the cooler back into PAIR mode after each reboot.
